pinch.text: Point and pinch. Point at a button and pinch your thumb and finger together to press it. With controllers, pull the trigger. Point at Next and pinch.

open-shop.text: Open the shopping list. Every piece of furniture is in here, in real-world sizes. Press Shopping list.

move.text: Move it. Point at any piece, near or far, and pinch to grab it. Move your hand, then let go. Grab the sofa and move it.

palette.text: Pick a palette. Each card is a set of colors. Pick one and the whole room changes to match. Pinch a palette card.

done.text: You're all set. The color wheel, briefs, lookbook and settings are all on the Palettes panel. Have fun!

drag-sofa.text: Drag in a sofa. Pinch a picture, drag it out into your room, and let go where you want it. Drag the sofa into your room.
